name: Bedford Marketplace

description: Bedford Marketplace is a well-established community shopping center located on Bedford Canyon Road in Corona, California. With its strategic positioning in Corona's retail corridor, Bedford Marketplace provides a comfortable shopping environment that caters to the daily needs of families and professionals in the area.
